item.title: About
item.description:
My research focuses on developing and applying computational methods to improve our understanding of disease risk and health outcomes:

  • Polygenic Score Transferability: Examining how genetic risk predictions perform across diverse populations and working to improve equity in precision medicine approaches

  • Women’s Health: Applying genomic and statistical methods to understand risk factors for women’s health conditions across the lifespan

  • Multi-Omics Integration: Combining genomic, environmental, and other high-dimensional data sources to build comprehensive models of disease risk
